title: Abéché rally supporting the government’s end to military cooperation with France
reason: Excluded: explicitly initiated by local authorities and framed as support/solidarity with the government. Reported slogans call for French forces to depart; no demand directed to Chad's own government is evidenced.
notes: Hundreds at Independence Square, per APAnews; TV5/AFP later notes a few hundred. Keep separate from N'Djamena Dec 6 event; reports are not automatically independent.

title: N’Djamena rally calling for French troops to leave
reason: Excluded: source evidence identifies an authorized meeting organized by parties/association to support an already-announced government decision; slogans and demands address France/French troops, with no demand to Chad’s own government. Party/political support purpose and foreign-directed demand fail target criteria.
notes: TV5MONDE/AFP reports approx. 300–500 at N'Djari; TchadActu records planned location and organizers. AFP is story origin; AP is only a photo credit on TV5. Threshold established but own-state target is not.
